description: This Java class, 'AnnotationBasedJsonParsable', is responsible for deserializing objects of type T from JSON using reflection. It implements the 'JsonParsable' interface and provides mechanisms to invoke a specified static parse method on a target class, handling exceptions and ensuring correct method signatures.

classes.name: AnnotationBasedJsonParsable
classes.description: A final class that provides deserialization of JSON objects into type T by invoking a specified static method reflectively.

methods.name: AnnotationBasedJsonParsable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deserialization strategy by confirming the existence and signature of the parsing method.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the API v2 key associated with this deserialization strategy.

methods.name: getV1FallbackKey
methods.description: Returns the API v1 fallback key; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Performs deserialization by invoking the specified static parsing method on JSON input, handling exceptions, and converting them into Ditto-specific exceptions.

methods.name: buildDittoJsonException
methods.description: Creates a detailed DittoJsonException wrapping the original cause of a parsing failure, including the JSON content.
